pr_title: 2D: Fix clip children and rendering artefacts
pr_body:
Closes #102147 Fixes both GLES3 and RendererRD implementations > [!NOTE] > > This fix also addresses the root cause of #101998, which was that instance buffers were reused in the same draw call, causing rendering artefacts.
Both issues resolved | clip children | rendering artefact | | :---- | :---- | | | |

issue_context.title: `CanvasItem.clip_children` has no effect
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.beta [a013481b0911e59cc3f3dea7ebb732450c3e1460]
- Not reproducible in: 4.4.beta1 [d33da79d3f8fe84be2521d25b9ba8e440cf25a88]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta (a013481b0) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.11029.1008) - AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

The `CanvasItem` property `clip_children`, which is meant to allow the parent to act as a mask for any of its `CanvasItem` children, seemingly has no effect in current `master` (a013481b0911e59cc3f3dea7ebb732450c3e1460).

Here's what it looked like in 4.4-beta1:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0156e4c-641d-4153-82d8-e9b3d70a215a)

Here's what it looks like now:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc242ecb-21ee-45fd-ad08-f60051753fb9)

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the MRP in latest `master`.
- Observe the issue.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[clip-children-bug-4.4.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18585252/clip-children-bug-4.4.zip)
comments:
~~Does that mean that clip children also doesn't work with `gl_compatibility`?~~

Yes

Thanks for reporting the issue!

I can confirm that clip children is also broken in gl_compatibility too, and happens to be the original inspiration for batching for the new renderer. I will keep digging!

review_comments: We need to start at the last instance buffer, even when starting the first batch. This is 0 when starting a new canvas draw, but will be non-zero if there are multiple draws in a single canvas draw.
